subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: For UUID-shaped Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan keys, should OpenClaw guide users away from `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`, expose a Lite-compatible DeepSeek route, or keep the current catalog and improve diagnostics only?
rationale: Current source and docs say one key registers both provider namespaces, but the reported failure suggests provider entitlement may differ by endpoint; automation cannot choose the product contract without live provider proof or maintainer intent.

options.title: Live-verify, then route or diagnose Lite keys
options.body: Use a credentialed Lite key to compare the general and coding endpoints, then make the Volcengine plugin route or warn according to the verified provider contract.

options.title: Document general-route unsupported
options.body: If Lite keys are only valid for Coding Plan, keep the general catalog for standard keys but update setup/docs/runtime diagnostics to prevent Lite users from selecting unsupported general models blindly.

options.title: Add a Lite-compatible model route
options.body: If the vendor supports DeepSeek through a different Lite/Coding endpoint, add the provider-owned catalog row and tests for that route instead of reusing the general `volcengine` row.

recommendation.title: Live-verify, then route or diagnose Lite keys
recommendation.body: Use a credentialed Lite key to compare the general and coding endpoints, then make the Volcengine plugin route or warn according to the verified provider contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice crosses provider auth alias behavior and plugin-owned routing, and steipete has the strongest current-history signal for that auth-alias boundary.
